::: {#def-data-set}

#### Data set

A **data set** is a finite collection of $\nobs$ labelled observations,
that is, $\nobs$ pairs $(\vpredvar_i, \outvar_i)$,
where $\vpredvar_i$ is an input vector
and $\outvar_i$ is the corresponding outcome:

$$
\dataset \eqdef \set{(\vpredvar_i, \outvar_i) : i = 1, \ldots, \nobs} .
$$ {#eq-data-set}

:::
